A lighter without these components is functionally indistinguishable from a generic plastic tube or lotion bottle. Real lighters have complex mechanical tops; these are smooth, featureless domes. The 'text_gibberish' severity of 3 is appropriate; the text 'SAI COAR' is nonsensical and distorted. The 'texture_anomaly' (severity 2) is also valid, as the patterns lack the crispness of real printing. The Topology Auditor's high confidence score (0.99) is misleading here—it confirms the object is a single blob, but fails to detect that the blob lacks necessary internal structure (the wheel/hood).
